window.__haugastolConsentState = { analytics: false, marketing: false };
window.gtag = window.gtag || function(){window.dataLayer.push(arguments);};
window.gtag('consent', 'default', {
  'analytics_storage': 'denied',
  'ad_storage': 'denied',
  'ad_user_data': 'denied',
  'ad_personalization': 'denied',
  'wait_for_update': 500
});
window.dataLayer.push({ event: 'consent_default_denied' });
(function(){
  function clearCookies(prefixes) {
    var hostname = window.location.hostname;
    var labels = hostname.split('.');
    var parentDomain = labels.length > 2 ? '.' + labels.slice(-2).join('.') : '';
    var domains = ['', hostname, '.' + hostname, parentDomain];
    var names = document.cookie.split(';').map(function(part) {
      return decodeURIComponent((part.split('=')[0] || '').trim());
    });
    names.forEach(function(name) {
      if (!name || !prefixes.some(function(prefix) {
        return name === prefix || name.indexOf(prefix) === 0;
      })) return;
      domains.forEach(function(domain) {
        var domainPart = domain ? '; Domain=' + domain : '';
        document.cookie = encodeURIComponent(name) + '=; Max-Age=0; Path=/' + domainPart + '; SameSite=Lax';
      });
    });
  }
  try {
    var raw = window.localStorage.getItem("haugastol_consent_v2");
    if (!raw) return;
    var stored = JSON.parse(raw);
    var valid =
      stored &&
      stored.version === 2 &&
      stored.policyVersion === "2026-10-05" &&
      stored.copyVersion === "2026-10-05" &&
      typeof stored.receiptId === 'string' &&
      stored.receiptId.length >= 16 &&
      typeof stored.createdAt === 'number' &&
      Number.isFinite(stored.createdAt) &&
      typeof stored.updatedAt === 'number' &&
      Number.isFinite(stored.updatedAt) &&
      typeof stored.expiresAt === 'number' &&
      Number.isFinite(stored.expiresAt) &&
      stored.expiresAt > Date.now() &&
      stored.necessary === true &&
      typeof stored.analytics === 'boolean' &&
      typeof stored.marketing === 'boolean';
    if (!valid) {
      window.localStorage.removeItem("haugastol_consent_v2");
      return;
    }
    if (!stored.analytics) clearCookies(['_ga', '_gid', '_gat']);
    if (!stored.marketing) clearCookies(['_gcl_', '_gac_', '_fbp', '_fbc']);
    var restored = {
      analytics_storage: stored.analytics ? 'granted' : 'denied',
      ad_storage: stored.marketing ? 'granted' : 'denied',
      ad_user_data: stored.marketing ? 'granted' : 'denied',
      ad_personalization: stored.marketing ? 'granted' : 'denied'
    };
    window.__haugastolConsentState = {
      analytics: stored.analytics,
      marketing: stored.marketing
    };
    window.gtag('consent', 'update', restored);
    window.dataLayer.push({
      event: 'consent_restored',
      consent_analytics: stored.analytics,
      consent_marketing: stored.marketing,
      consent_version: 'v2'
    });
  } catch (_) {}

space-y-6"><p class="text-[0.68rem] uppercase tracking-[0.3em] text-white/82 md:text-[0.74rem]">Haugastøl 1000 MOH</p><h1 class="text-5xl font-medium leading-[0.93] tracking-tight md:text-[5.35rem] lg:text-[6.1rem]">Snowkite guiding</h1><p class="max-w-2xl text-base text-white/90 md:text-[1.18rem]">Haugastøl and surrounding areas offers world class snowkiting. The variety in spots are almost unlimited, and you can kite here for years and still not visit the same spot twice.</p><div class="flex flex-wrap gap-3 pt-2"><a class="rounded-none bg-white px-8 py-3 text-[0.68rem] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.18em] text-[#16120f]" style="color:#16120f" href="/en/booking">Book your stay</a><a class="rounded-none border border-white/74 px-8 py-3 text-[0.68rem] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.18em] text-white" href="/en/packages">Explore experiences</a></div></div></div></section><section class="mx-auto w-full max-w-[1240px] px-6 py-8 md:hidden"><aside class="border border-[#ddd5c8] bg-white p-4  md:hidden" aria-label="Table of contents"><p class="text-[0.68rem] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.14em] text-[#6a645d]">Contents</p><nav class="mt-3"><ul class="space-y-2"><li><a href="#intro" class="text-sm text-[#1d1916] hover:underline">Intro</a></li><li><a href="#kontakt" class="text-sm text-[#1d1916] hover:underline">Contact</a></li><li><a href="#bilder" class="text-sm text-[#1d1916] hover:underline">Gallery</a></li></ul></nav></aside></section><section class="mx-auto w-full max-w-[1240px] px-6 py-12 md:py-16"><div class="grid gap-6 md:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_280px]"><div class="space-y-10 md:space-y-12"><section id="intro" class="scroll-mt-28 border border-[#ddd5c8] bg-white p-6 md:p-7"><a class="booking-cta-on-light mt-6 inline-block rounded-none border border-[#1d1916] bg-[#1d1916] px-7 py-3 text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.12em] text-white" style="color:#fff" href="/en/booking">Book now</a></section><section id="en-opplevelse-tett-pa-naturen" class="scroll-mt-28 grid gap-5 md:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_360px] "><article class="border border-[#ddd5c8] bg-white p-6 md:p-7"><p class="mt-4 whitespace-pre-line text-[#4a453f]">When you are a guest at the hotel you benefit from our local knowledge of snowkiting in the area for over 15 years. Even with the tips you get at the hotel we have had an increasing amount of guests that are looking for snowkite guides to take them to the best spots.

For some it&#x27;s just improving their snowkite skills, and others want longer trips into the backcountry of one of our National Parks. Our guides can be booked for just a few hours, or during your whole week of snowkiting.</p></article><div class="relative min-h-[18rem] overflow-hidden border border-[#ddd5c8] bg-white"><button
